Create exactly one 2x2 atlas, canvas ratio 64:35, four equal cells, each a complete 64x35 upper-face crop. No labels, borders, gutters, zooms, or extra panels. Cell order: top-left LEFT OPEN, top-right RIGHT OPEN; bottom-left LEFT HALF, bottom-right RIGHT HALF.

Only make a modest synchronized horizontal gaze shift of about one native pixel: in LEFT cells shift both compact iris/pupil clusters toward the character's left; in RIGHT cells shift them toward the character's right. Both eyes track together. Do not move the iris clusters vertically, enlarge them, reshape them, or change their color.

The iris is partly occluded by the lid; do not shrink the iris to fit, do not fully expose it, and do not reopen the eye. Keep half-row lids at the same narrow coverage as the supplied lower-row source. Do not widen either eye or add white sclera to fit a whole pupil. No broad pale sclera bands, white patches, new highlights, or flash.

No other facial changes, no changed brows or creases, no enlarged eyes, no round/vector irises, no blur, gradients, text, watermark, or extra subjects.
